summary: Defines the Target-Dialog header field and the tdialog option tag for the Session Initiation Protocol. A request that creates a SIP dialog can use it to tell the recipient that the sender knows about an existing dialog with it. The recipient can use this to decide whether to authorize the request. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Before you knock on a door, you say which earlier conversation you are following up on. The person inside can then tell you really were part of it and let you in.

questions: how to authorize sip requests using dialog id
